project.name: OmniFlow
project.purpose: AI-native business operations platform; current FYP/MVP scope is narrower than the long-term vision.

interpretationRules: The root README is aspirational product vision and legacy stack context, not an implementation checklist.
roadmap.md checkboxes are owner-maintained claims and must be corroborated by code and tests.
Do not mark a feature complete from a route or UI component alone.
Separate native functionality, mock/demo functionality, and live third-party integrations.
Never include secret values in evaluator output.

statusDefinitions.implemented: Implementation evidence and relevant automated verification both exist.
statusDefinitions.partial: Some implementation exists, but acceptance criteria or verification are incomplete.
statusDefinitions.planned: Explicitly in roadmap/vision; no implementation evidence established.

requirements.name: Tasks and projects
acceptance: Create, update, assign, prioritize, and complete tasks
Persist task/project data with organization isolation
Task-to-commitment lifecycle is covered by tests
Production build and end-to-end workflow pass

requirements.name: Docs and wiki
acceptance: Create and edit documents
Index document content
Retrieve relevant passages with organization isolation
Indexing failures are recoverable and visible

requirements.name: Contextual Knowledge Mesh
acceptance: Chunk and embed supported sources
Persist and retrieve vectors scoped to organization
Expose source-grounded retrieval results
Handle gateway limits, timeouts, and reindexing safely

requirements.name: Micro-Commitment Tracker
acceptance: Capture owner, counterparty, promise, due date, and status
Link commitments to tasks where applicable
Detect duplicates and update lifecycle correctly
Validate risk scoring against labeled examples

requirements.name: Client Expectation Mapper
acceptance: Capture client and internal definitions of done
Identify semantic gaps with evidence
Track expectation changes over time
Validate risk flags against reviewed examples

requirements.name: Silent Dependency Monitor
acceptance: Discover dependencies from real source/config inputs
Map affected modules and owners
Explain risk with traceable evidence
Validate findings against known breaking changes

requirements.name: AI CEO and autonomous operations
acceptance: Define agent scope and allowed actions
Require organization-scoped authorization
Record before/after values and rationale
Support pause, retry, rollback, and human approval for high-impact actions
Cover all claimed agent pillars or explicitly narrow product claims

requirements.name: AI hiring intelligence
acceptance: Document ethical constraints and human oversight
Implement explainable, job-related evaluation only
Test for bias and accessibility

requirements.name: Production connector framework
acceptance: Define connector contract and OAuth/token lifecycle
Implement webhook/event ingestion and retry handling
Demonstrate each connector against a sandbox/live test account
Publish a verified connector inventory

requirements.name: Team chat and unified inbox
acceptance: Unified message model and permissions
Slack connection and sync
Idempotent event processing

requirements.name: Email and calendar integration
acceptance: Microsoft 365/Outlook authorization
Sync, send, and event reconciliation
Retry and token refresh handling

requirements.name: Meetings and telephony
acceptance: Scheduling and meeting provider integration
Call provider integration tested in sandbox
Recording/transcript consent and retention controls

requirements.name: Build and static analysis
acceptance: Production build passes in CI
Lint passes in CI
Type checking is enforced
Type checking is still not enforced; add a dedicated typecheck command and CI step.

requirements.name: Automated test suite
acceptance: Unit tests cover critical pure logic
Integration tests cover auth, RLS, persistence, and AI gateway failures
E2E tests cover key FYP workflows

requirements.name: Secrets and environment hygiene
acceptance: Ignore local environment files
Provide placeholder-only environment template
Run history-aware secret scanning
Store credentials in deployment/GitHub secrets only
Rotate any credential found in public history
